thread:
maria: T-minus 10 to change window. Quick sync: smoke, canary targets, pin policy? Any last-minute release note updates?
pm-ryan: Release notes live: https://releases.redwood.dev/notes/v3.0.0 -> highlights: batching refactor, kv-cache resilience, auth token refresh logic.
ben: Canaries in prod-us-west and prod-eu are prewarmed. Stage smoke green at 09:48 UTC.
deploy-bot: CANARY STARTED \u2014 release=v3.0.0 env=prod-us-west canary_id=cb-20260322-01
infra-oncall: Observability: request errors rising on internal-auth at 09:51 UTC, 401s from auth-proxy cluster. p95 latency still ok.
dani: Seeing lots of 401s in canary logs for token refresh calls. Looks like the new auth refresh path is hitting an expired client secret in k8s secret.
maria: If internal-auth returns 401s -> embeddings/embedding-service will 5xx. Hold full rollout unless fixed.
ben: Pin plan: edge + api-gateway -> hold at v2.9.9 for 1h; only canary traffic to v3.0.0 for now.
pm-ryan: Assign owners: dani (deploy + rollback), ben (pin audit), infra-oncall (auth secret), maria (comms)
infra-oncall: Confirmed: client-secret rotation failed at 06:00 UTC earlier. I'll rotate secret now and restart auth-proxy.
deploy-bot: METRIC ALERT canary_id=cb-20260322-01 anomalies detected: auth_401_rate=23% (threshold=2%)
dani: Running roll command to stop canary traffic while infra rotates:
```
deployctl pause-canary --id cb-20260322-01 --reason "auth 401 spike"
deployctl pin --route api-gateway --version v2.9.9 --owner ben
```
deploy-bot: CANARY PAUSED canary_id=cb-20260322-01 actor=dani
infra-oncall: Secret rotated and auth-proxy pods restarted. Waiting for token refresh handshakes.
ben: Pin enforced on api-gateway -> v2.9.9. Edge pins queued.
deploy-bot: CANARY RESUME ATTEMPT canary_id=cb-20260322-01
infra-oncall: Auth 401s dropped to ~0.3% after restart, but we saw a brief cascade where embeddings returned 502s for ~90s.
maria: Given the cascade, let's extend the freeze for this window and hold rollout. Schedule a hotfix branch to revert auth refresh change until we can add more retry logic.
pm-ryan: I'll open a quick RFC + rollback rationale in the release doc and notify support/legal if needed.
dani: Kicking off rollback of canary to be safe and marking this window as "freeze-extended". Command:
```
deployctl rollback --canary cb-20260322-01 --reason "third-party auth rotation caused 401 cascade"
```
deploy-bot: ROLLBACK STARTED canary_id=cb-20260322-01 actor=dani
deploy-bot: ROLLBACK COMPLETE canary_id=cb-20260322-01 status=success
ben: All pins verified. Edge + api-gateway pinned at v2.9.9. Mobile rollout halted.
maria: Decision log: abort full rollout for v3.0.0 pending hotfix. Owners: dani (hotfix & retest), infra-oncall (secret rotation validation), ben (pin audit), pm-ryan (customer comms). Postmortem: https://docs.redwood.dev/postmortems/2026-03-22-auth-cascade
pm-ryan: Proposed timeline: hotfix branch today, extended smoke + 2h quiesce, re-canary tomorrow morning UTC.
infra-oncall: Also going to add a k8s check to validate client-secret age during deploy windows.
maria: Good, closing this window as freeze-extended. Thanks everyone :handshake:
pm-ryan: Notifying support and sending a short blurb to #customer-notify.
ben: Filing a follow-up ticket to add alert: auth_401_rate > 1% for 1m -> paged alert.
maria: End of thread.
summary: v3.0.0 canary paused due to a client-secret rotation causing auth 401s and a brief embedding cascade. Team paused canary, rotated secret, rolled back canary, pinned routes to v2.9.9, and extended the freeze with a hotfix + follow-ups scheduled.
